pull-request-header: :construction: Pre-release from `develop`. Tags `vX.Y.Z-pre.N` and marks the GitHub Release as a pre-release. Does **not** update the Homebrew tap. Promote by merging `develop` into `main` (merge commit, never squash). That merge opens a *stable* release PR on main because main records the last stable in `.release-please-manifest.json`, not this `-pre`. Merging develop does not itself create `vX.Y.Z`.
